title: job.created
description: A job (a traveller) entered the graph. Parity with flowpilot's EventKind.CREATED.

title.description: The title of the job at the moment of creation.

entry_node_id.description: The node of the graph the job is born on. cartografo has no fixed states: the entry node is data of the graph version in force.

body.description: The body of the job, when it is born with content (the intake). null when nobody wrote one.

acceptance_criteria.description: PRELIMINARY acceptance criteria, as the intake proposed them. What really produces them is the node that refines, out of the raw request. null and [] are different things.

fields.description: Values of the fields the CLASS declares in its own graph (`custom_fields`, t168) — `premise_source`, `downside` and `upside` in asymmetric bets. Free keys on purpose: what declares them is the class's graph document, not this taxonomy. null when the job was born with no field at all; null and {} are different things.

tier.description: The job's cost triage (t175): how much it costs to RUN, never which edge it leaves by — the graph stays frozen. A closed set because the vocabulary is this triage's and not the engine's: a third value is a mistake by whoever wrote it. null when nobody triaged, and null is NOT `trivial` — reading an absence as cheap would downgrade the model of every job older than this ficha without anybody having chosen that.
